headline: As of 2026-10-20: 11,805,915 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 40 of 50 states, D+18.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 11,805,915 early/mail ballots cast so far across 40 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+18.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,523,009), Florida (1,141,193), Georgia (1,032,020).
